scientific_difference: The exact PR35 eight-file annotation parent versus ten reviewed endpoint-slot amendments on six retained rows in two disjoint training images: three visible-coordinate corrections, three visible-to-missing changes and four missing-to-visible changes. The fourth newly visible slot is the rechecked upper right corner new_000023:33 at (612, 549); its moderate-confidence dissent remains recorded. No new boxes, objects or split changes. hypothesis: Correcting wrong-side visibility and misplaced endpoint supervision may reduce returned points on reference-unlocatable sides while preserving locatable coverage, detection and accurate point pairs. A decrease caused by missed objects or blanket endpoint suppression does not support this hypothesis.

evaluation.unlocatable_slot_comparison: Use the same reference-unlocatable slots on objects matched by both members of each pair; report numerator, denominator and identities. Also report unconditional outputs and unmatched-object counts.
evaluation.locatable_coverage: Report returned/reference-locatable slots over the full reference and the same common-matched objects; report missing returned slots and coordinate errors.
required_results: All-object matches, misses, duplicate and other extras, and review workload
Zero/one/two-locatable-corner group recall with complete denominators
Both-corner 5/10px successes over all 584 eligible objects, including failures to detect
Common-matched unlocatable-slot outputs together with locatable-slot coverage
All gained/lost object and pair-success identities, with original-image assignment review
Miss-free nonempty scenes and every output on the three empty images
The exact current PR35 checkpoint at identical inference/reference settings
evaluation.decision: At the fixed primary confidence 0.13, require supported endpoint-availability or localization improvement against the matched old_reviewed control while preserving object completeness: no additional supported lost matches and no higher missed-object count. Preserve locatable-slot coverage and existing 5px and 10px pair successes; empty scenes must have no added outputs. Inspect extras and all gained/lost identities against original pixels. Newly found objects are not required for an endpoint benefit, but fewer unlocatable-slot outputs caused by missed objects or blanket endpoint suppression do not qualify. Assess replacement of the exact operational PR35 checkpoint separately at these same settings and preservation criteria. IoU/assignment crossings and uncertain labels do not establish physical recovery. No automatic promotion or threshold/seed/epoch/subset search.
